comment: * A source that uses GZIP to * decompress data read from another source. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: section
variables.comment: The current section. Always progresses forward.

variables.name: source
variables.comment:
* Our source should yield a GZIP header (which we consume directly), followed
   * by deflated bytes (which we consume via an InflaterSource), followed by a
   * GZIP trailer (which we also consume directly).

variables.name: inflater
variables.comment: The inflater used to decompress the deflated body.

variables.name: inflaterSource
variables.comment:
* The inflater source takes care of moving data between compressed source and
   * decompressed sink buffers.

variables.name: crc
variables.comment: Checksum used to check both the GZIP header and decompressed body.

methods.name: public long read(Buffer sink, long byteCount) throws IOException
private void updateCrc(Buffer buffer, long offset, long byteCount)
methods.comment: Updates the CRC with the given bytes.

methods.name: private void checkEqual(String name, int expected, int actual) throws IOException
